title: ROLE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN PREDICTING OUTCOMES OF CLINICAL TRIALS IN ONCOLOGY

live_model.evidence: Model table: 'GPT-4 LLM (Closed-source) gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 Dec 2023'; Table 1: 'GPT-4 0.542 0.234 1.000 0.083' (Balanced Accuracy, MCC, Recall, Specificity)

prompt.location: Sec. 'Model Input and Prediction Process': 'Each model was prompted with structured trial data using a standardized instruction: "Use the following clinical trial data to predict whether the outcome will be a success or failure. Reply..."'

claim.location: Table 1, row GPT-4 (MCC 0.234, Recall 1.000, Specificity 0.083 in the same row); '712 were oncology-specific trials' out of 2,163 total extracted

data.source: ClinicalTrials.gov (publicly accessible database), interventional oncology trials, Phases I-III, completed 2015-2023

notes: GPT-4o in this paper is pinned to the rolling alias 'chatgpt-4o-latest' (not a dated snapshot), so despite GPT-4o's higher balanced accuracy (0.573) it is treated as unresolved/non-reproducible; GPT-4 (gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09) is the cleanest live-listed result in this paper.
